verdict.rationale: Fellow is a meeting-notes SaaS with an API, webhooks, and an MCP server, so asking whether its automations can be versioned and rolled back is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review/diff, or rollback of automations or workflows. The API, webhooks, and round-trippable Fellow Markdown are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself, so they earn no credit.
